title.zh: Senate Blocks CLARITY Act 49-50 With No Democratic Votes to Proceed

current_state.zh: The U.S. Senate blocked a motion to proceed to the CLARITY Act in a 49-50 cloture vote, with no Democratic support and four Republicans voting no.
